red-beet-soup.recipe:
---
title: Red beet soup
tags: vegetarian, vegan
threads: 2
time: 60
---

This soup is kinda good, but mostly you make it because of its cool color.

## Ingredients
- red beets
- potatoes
- vegetable broth
- onion(s)
- bay leaves
- (olive) oil
- salt
- pepper

### Optional
- unsweetened yogurt or sour cream
- cheese to grate

## Equipment
- hand blender

## Steps
- chop the onion finely and sauté it in some oil inside a tall pot
- dice the red beets and the potatoes

- add the vegetables to the pot and stir for about 5 minutes
- warm the broth up

- pour the broth into the pot and bring it to a boil. Let everything cook for at least 15-20 minutes, until both the beets and the potatoes are soft
- grate a generous amount of cheese

- turn off the stove and blend everything together
- season with salt, pepper and optionally some extra oil and a bit of yogurt or sour cream

punsch-ice-cream.recipe:
---
title: Punsch ice cream
tags: dessert, vegetarian
threads: 2
time: 20
---

Note: If you prefer a softer & sweeter ice cream, then use more punsch (liquor) or sugar respectively. If you prefer it more icy and firmer then use less alcohol and sugar. I highly dont recommend going above 1.5 dl liquor as it'll feel like ice cream shots.

## Ingredients

- 5-6 eggs
- 0.5-1.5 dl Punsch (liquor)
- 1-3 dl sugar
- 5-6 dl whipping cream

### Optional

- Chocolate

## Equipment

- Electric whisk or anything that whips the cream

## Steps

- Crack the eggs in a bowl and put the sugar in. Whisk it to a smooth texture then add the liquor and mix
- Turn the whipping cream into whipped cream
- Cut the chocolate into tiny pieces

- Mix everything together, optionally save some chocolate to add as sprinkles on top.

- Pour into containers and freeze for minimum 8 hours
